policy: Instructional demonstrations and incomplete swings are valid observations. Record elbow posture in the motion detail. A practice swing does not prove a strike, ball flight, shot direction or quality. Do not use on-screen subtitles as motion evidence.

terms.label: address_adjustment
terms.definition: Visible repositioning of feet, body, hands or club into address. The stationary address is held_pose.

terms.label: backswing
terms.definition: Club/arms visibly move away from address toward the top. Do not invent the missing beginning of a cropped swing.

terms.label: downswing
terms.definition: Observable return of club/arms from the top toward the potential contact region; can be a slow instructional demonstration.

terms.label: strike
terms.definition: A visibly supported club-ball interaction or clearly observed ball departure. Club passage alone is insufficient; contact anchor may remain null.

terms.label: follow_through
terms.definition: Continuing club/body movement after the bottom of the swing; do not imply actual ball contact.

terms.label: elbow_flexion
terms.definition: A distinct visible decrease in elbow angle. Merely maintaining a bent elbow during another phase is an attribute/pose.

terms.label: elbow_extension
terms.definition: A distinct visible increase in elbow angle. State which arm only when visible.

terms.label: reset
terms.definition: Visible return from a demonstration/swing to a new starting position.
